name: December
objective: Renew on personal usage data, pre-sell January (which now feeds the February challenge), and turn Christmas gifting into new clients.
strategy:
Wrapped.

Commercial job: Renew on personal usage data, pre-sell January (which now feeds the February challenge), and turn Christmas gifting into new clients.

Newcomer: Kickstart 21: Pre-Order (“Buy in December. Start Mon 3 Jan. Arrive ready for Stronger in 30.”). Moves January demand into December cash and lands graduates in the February challenge.

Newcomer: Gift the Shake (“The Christmas gift that gets them moving.”). Christmas gifting, reusing the Diwali mechanic.

Winback: Your 2027 Wrapped (“You took {n} classes with us. Here's 20% off the sequel.”). Year-in-review pages get shared and remind lapsed clients of their own habit.

Renewal: Wrapped & Renewed (“Your year in numbers, and next year at a better price.”). A usage-based recommendation renews members onto the right product before the February challenge.

Renewal: 12 Days of Shakemas (“Twelve days, twelve published deals. Day 12 is the big one.”). A daily reason to renew in the year's last selling fortnight; the best prices sit on the longest plans.
notes:
Moment: 'Your 2027 Wrapped' — a personal year-in-review for every client; the published 12 Days of Shakemas calendar (13–24 Dec).
Build: new clients 40 buyers × ₹12,000 = ₹4.8L; reactivation 40 × ₹11,468 = ₹4.6L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹3.5L; renewals ₹25.6L. First visits needed 134 vs 98 last year (1.37×); CRM leads needed 268 vs 72 last year.
